OptionDesc.RendererStatus: An older installation is shown as update available. Install / Update reinstalls from the bundled payload without downloading.
OptionDesc.InstallRenderer: Verify the bundled payload, clear %LOCALAPPDATA%\CSLModernMap\Renderer, and reinstall the renderer.
OptionDesc.OpenRendererFolder: Open the renderer installation folder in the system file manager.
OptionDesc.Version: The version of the mod you have installed.
OptionDesc.ExportAndOpen: Export the current city, then open that file in the renderer shipped with this mod. A failed export never starts the renderer.
OptionDesc.ExportCurrentCity: Write the current city to a .cmm.gz in the export folder without starting anything.
OptionDesc.OpenExportFolder: Open the export folder in the system file manager. If it cannot be opened, the path is copied instead.
OptionDesc.CopyExportFolderPath: Copy the full export folder path to the clipboard.
